name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a PennyLane program with a QNode t
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a PennyLane program with a QNode that applies RX(1.462) and RY(1.856) to one qubit and returns <Z>. Print the result and the analytic value cos(1.462)*cos(1.856). Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
